map.依据国知局 2024 年现行收费标准，计算专利各阶段官费，费减后费用另计，辅助预: Based on the CNIPA 2024 official fee schedule, computing the official fees at each patent stage, with reduced fees counted separately, to assist budgeting.
map.申请专利前，按类型（发明/实用新型/外观）与阶段（申请/实审/授权/年费）估算官: Before filing a patent, estimate the official fees by type (invention / utility model / design) and stage (application / examination / grant / annuity).
map.已申请费用减缴的，个人减缴 85%、单位减缴 70%。: Once a fee reduction has been applied, individuals get 85% off and organizations 70% off.
map.叠加代理服务费做预算。: Add the agency service fee for budgeting.
map.：申请费 900 × 15% = 135 元 + 印刷费 50（不减）= 185: Application fee 900 x 15% = 135 CNY + printing fee 50 (not reduced) = 185 CNY; including the substantive examination fee 2500 x 15% = 375 and the grant printing fee 255, official fees total about 815 CNY.
map.：申请费 500 × 15% = 75 + 印刷费 50 + 授权印花费 205: Application fee 500 x 15% = 75 + printing fee 50 + grant printing fee 205, giving about 330 CNY in official fees after the reduction (no substantive examination fee).
map.费用减缴条件？: What are the fee reduction conditions?
map.个人上年度月均收入低于 5000 元、企业应纳税所得额低于 100 万元等可申请: Individuals with prior-year average monthly income below 5000 CNY and enterprises with taxable income below 1 million CNY and so on may apply; the reduction is 85% of the fees (individuals) or 70% (organizations).
map.年费每年一样吗？: Is the annual fee the same every year?
map.不一样，年费随年度递增（如发明第 1–3 年 900、第 4–6 年 1200…: They differ, and the annual fee increases each year (for invention patents year 1-3 is 900, year 4-6 is 1200, and so on); it should be paid before the anniversary of the filing date, and a late payment surcharge applies.
